caption:
Taking It Off

How do you remove your makeup?

There are countless cleansers,
and the internet is never short of opinions.
Of course, it depends on your skin
and how much makeup you wear.
But as a woman in my forties,
and as a makeup artist,
my answer is simple: a cream cleanser.

For brows, eyes and lips,
a gentle point remover, used softly but thoroughly.
For the rest of the face,
a fine cream cleanser that supports ageing care.

Many see cleansing as a chore —
something to simply get through.
Yet it is the only step in skincare that takes away,
which makes it the one that asks most of your skin.
That is exactly why it deserves your attention,
and the best you can give it.

Change your cleanser, and your skin changes.
I believe your world does too.

How do you spend your cleansing time?
